original_finding.replacement: productionCurrentPrivateInputsOpened=false; ownedPrivateInputReadAttempted before first owned-plan read; ownedPrivateInputReadCompleted only after it returns

reviewed_flow: Fixed reviewed public module pins are checked before loading the custody helpers; actual HeldT5 anchors and diskutil UUID precede any owned private plan/config/admission read.

Only two fixed owned generations and exact loopback flat normal native_v6_file configuration are accepted. Binary whole SHA, exact size/mode and stable FD/name identity are checked before and after manager admission.
Manager admission binds generation, plan hash and actual wrapper PID/birth/executable identity. The wrapper only prepares exec; it does not claim server startup.
All Commands must be known completed and reaped, guard descriptors must close with a final anchor, pending cancellation must be absent and original 30 seconds must remain before the single os.execve.
The final three-hunk delta also restores available TERM/INT/PIPE/XFZ/XFSZ defaults before exec; it adds no launch retry, new deadline or child.
required_caller_boundary: The manager must bind the exact reviewed public pins/plan and independently observe the same PID and birth become the pinned server executable.
ready/public stdout/candidate alone is never service startup, manager success or production-switch authorization.
A partial private read is reported as attempted; failure receipts and any nonzero exit cannot be treated as a completed startup.
limitations: Source-only review of this wrapper and its precise delta; no independent manager, launchd, AST, host, service or real exec result is claimed.
The existing conservative descriptor/command failure behavior remains; exceptions during close or output prevent successful exec even if a partial candidate file already exists.
No runtime operation is authorized by this peer receipt; B HA quiet is unchanged.
